Nora: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a tiny "cohort_fence" add-on for model metadata (soft|hard), an expires_at, and a compat signature. Purpose: safer rollouts and deterministic runtime enforcement.

Ethan: Can you paste the minimal example?

Nora: Sure: {cohort_id:"2026-06-a", cohort_fence:"soft", expires_at:"2026-06-10T00:00:00Z", grace_seconds:"3600", compat_sig:"sha256:aa.."}  Soft = warn + grace, hard = reject routing.

Kai: Runtime must enforce hard fences regardless of client version. For soft, runtime should emit a header X-Model-Cohort + metric cohort_mismatch_total.

Ethan: Cache note: annotate prefix/KV entries with cohort_id so node agents can evict on hard expiry. Soft expiry -> mark stale and revalidate.

Nora: Surface plan: metadata endpoint /v1/models/:id/metadata + optional headers and console UI. Migration phases: visibility -> warnings -> throttles -> enforcement.

ops-bot: Canary deployment for "cohort-fence-try" started (build 97) - https://staging.internal/release/397/logs

Kai: Tenant override allowed for soft only, admin + audit required. Hard fences no override.

Ethan: I'll sketch enforcement matrix. Nora will draft JSON Schema. Kai takes cache changes.

Nora: Thanks, will send RFC draft tomorrow.
